wechatCacheCopyFeedback.userReportedTrigger: Appeared after clearing cache or recompiling.
wechatCacheCopyFeedback.sourceCodeObservation: For ordinary ENOENT, _cache removes the failed queue entry and schedules the next item after 500 ms. The evidence does not establish an infinite retry of the same item. Initialization trusts cacheList.json. Reading a missing cachedFiles entry removes it and returns the read error without immediately downloading it again.
wechatCacheCopyFeedback.impact: The index still references missing persistent files, so a later resource load may fail once and need a retry rather than merely run slower. The already-loaded level remains usable according to the user.
wechatCacheCopyFeedback.hypothesis: Stale queued paths after cache clearing are consistent with the symptoms, but the cause is not fully proven.
wechatCacheCopyFeedback.suggestedNextAction: Fully close and reopen the project, compile once to rebuild the queue, and observe whether the failures recur.
